sources.title: ATO: How to vary your PAYG instalments
sources.fact: Read by an agent on 24 September 2026 (page last updated 23 June 2026); not yet reviewed by a person. Vary by amount (option 1, T7) or rate (option 2, T2). Instalment income is gross business and investment income excluding GST. Quarterly amount: cumulative share of estimated tax for the quarter less instalments paid (for example 75% by the third quarter, 100% by the fourth); a nil or negative result may give a credit at 5B. Varied rate is estimated tax divided by estimated instalment income times 100. If varied instalments are less than 85% of total tax payable, GIC may apply to the difference, and penalties in some circumstances; no penalty or interest where reasonable care was taken.
